title: Cambiar el trabajo vigente sin congelarlo
objective: Permitir corregir trabajo vivo (requisito y tareas, regla local, roadmap futuro, discard de scope) sin congelarlo por la protección del historial, sin borrar evidencia y sin mentir el handoff.
successCriteria: A person can correct a live requirement and the current tasks that depend on it in one authorized change, without losing prior evidence or stopping unrelated ready work.
A local process rule can be replaced so only the new rule is treated as effective, without opening a new sprint or filing debt as a workaround.
Upcoming planned sprints can be reorganized without changing the identity of sprints already closed or active.
A live scope that is no longer needed can be discarded with one informed approval, leaving an abandoned close and a retired scope.
Kyro never instructs executing a task when none is ready; after a live change, doctor reports managed state intact.

requirements.statement: One authorized active-plan update can change a live requirement together with its current tasks, including removing the requirement or cancelling a task when the same request relinks or disposes live consumers.
requirements.rationale: Everyday case 1. Extends Plan 14 preview/digest/apply (E1, E10); does not add a revision journal (decision 2). Validation: one --update-active request; evidence kept; unrelated pass survives; remove without relink writes nothing.

requirements.statement: A scope-local convention can be updated, removed, or replaced so the old rule is no longer effective while its text remains in local history.
requirements.rationale: Everyday case 2. Closed decision 5: local only in v1; --global/mirrors excluded because that path exploded Plan 15 (H2, E4). Validation: rule replace; packs omit old id; doctor clean.

requirements.statement: Future roadmap entries in planned state can be retitled, added, cancelled, or reordered in presentation without renumbering closed or active sprint identities.
requirements.rationale: Everyday case 3. Closed decision 3: dedicated plan --roadmap, not mixed into --update-active, so current-sprint edits stay scoped (E5). Validation: cancel planned n; closed archive identity unchanged.

requirements.statement: A live scope can be discarded under one informed approval that cancels undisposed current work, closes the sprint as abandoned, and retires the scope, resuming from the same digest if interrupted.
requirements.rationale: Everyday case 4. Closed decision 4: orchestrate existing close-abandoned and retire writers (E6); no new WAL. --yes is mechanical; discard itself is human consent (I8). Validation: inspect abandoned+retired; retry digest; prior archives unchanged.

requirements.statement: Kyro never advertises execute_task without a dependency-ready next task, and a dead route exposes a structured blocker with a copy-pastable remedy command.
requirements.rationale: Prevents independent work from freezing (I3, E3, E8). Closed decision 6: no new NextAction enum; skill uses remedyCommand. Validation: dispose last unfinished; status/context-pack JSON.

requirements.statement: After a successful live-work write in this scope, doctor reports intact managed state, sprint schema remains 4, and no live-revision or project-convention-transaction records are created.
requirements.rationale: Doctor is the integrity net (I6, E9); schema 4 (I7, decision 1 base 36c3897). Finding 06: proofs must use this checkout CLI, not PATH Plan 15. Validation: doctor --json/--artifacts; tree has no revision journal.

requirements.statement: Closed sprints, close checkpoints, completion and retirement records, evidence blobs, and pass verdicts stay immutable while open-scope current work remains editable.
requirements.rationale: Invariant live≠archive (I1). Prevents history protection from rewriting archives. Validation: discard/update does not change hashes of unrelated archives.

requirements.statement: Changing one live part keeps prior evidence on the task as history, clears only affected current approval, and does not block unrelated ready work.
requirements.rationale: Invariant evidence-is-not-a-lock (I2) plus independent continuation. Plan 14 already invalidates affected verdicts; this scope must not erase blobs. Validation: case 1 fixture with an unrelated pass task.

requirements.statement: Live-work changes are tool-owned CLI writes under the existing writer lock; agents do not hand-edit managed JSON; discard and retire still require informed human approval.
requirements.rationale: Invariants I4 and I8. Closed decision 2: Plan 14 ceremony, not a journal. Validation: no agent-written sprint.json; discard without --yes is CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

scenarios.given: un sprint activo con una tarea independiente lista
scenarios.when: otra tarea se bloquea o se dispone
scenarios.then: el handoff conserva la tarea lista como nextTaskId y no anuncia un bloqueo falso

scenarios.given: un sprint activo sin tareas dependency-ready tras disponer la última tarea
scenarios.then: no se anuncia execute_task con nextTaskId nulo y se expone blocker no_ready_work con remedyCommand

scenarios.given: un requisito vivo con escenarios y tareas consumidoras
scenarios.when: una solicitud --update-active relinka o cancela los consumidores y elimina el requisito
scenarios.then: el cambio se prepara por digest y se aplica atómicamente sin dejar referencias vivas

scenarios.when: se ejecuta rule update, remove o replace local con el digest aprobado
scenarios.then: sólo la regla resultante sigue efectiva y el texto anterior queda en historia local

scenarios.given: una escritura viva exitosa de Sprint 1
scenarios.then: el managed state es íntegro, el schema es 4 y no existe registro de live revision ni transacción de convención de proyecto

scenarios.given: evidencia, veredictos pass y archivos de sprint previos
scenarios.when: se aplica una edición de trabajo vivo
scenarios.then: las evidencias y archivos históricos permanecen inmutables

scenarios.given: una tarea afectada y una tarea pass no relacionada
scenarios.then: se conserva la evidencia, se borra sólo la aprobación afectada y la tarea no relacionada sigue aprobada

scenarios.given: un cambio de trabajo vivo autorizado
scenarios.when: se previsualiza y aplica mediante el CLI
scenarios.then: el writer lock y el digest son obligatorios y ningún agente edita JSON gestionado

scenarios.given: un roadmap con entradas planned y al menos un sprint closed o active
scenarios.when: plan --roadmap retitula, añade, cancela o reordena en presentación entradas planned
scenarios.then: sólo cambian las entradas planned; las identidades n de closed/active y sus archives permanecen intactos

scenarios.given: una entrada de roadmap closed o active
scenarios.when: plan --roadmap intenta cancelarla, renumerarla o alterar su identidad de ejecución
scenarios.then: el comando rechaza y no escribe estado gestionado

scenarios.given: un scope vivo con sprint activo y tareas undisposed
scenarios.when: scope discard se previsualiza y se aplica con un digest y un consentimiento
scenarios.then: las tareas undisposed quedan cancelled, el sprint cierra abandoned, el scope queda retired, y un reintento del mismo digest no diverge ni altera archives ajenos

scenarios.given: un context-pack o status con blocker.remedyCommand para trabajo vivo ya autorizado
scenarios.when: el helper de skill de forge/executor consume ese comando
scenarios.then: aplica el cambio y corre doctor sin turno extra de usuario; discard u otra expansión de autoridad sí lo piden

nonGoals: Project-wide --global convention or principle mutation, legacy mirrors, or provenance ledgers
plan --revise, schema 5, revision records, pending-revision writer fences, or close-blocking applicability obligations
Accepted-ADR link maintenance, question resolve/withdraw, and debt cancel unless a later red fixture proves a dead end with no v1 verb
Lens, MCP, whole-product W7 certification, or a new multi-file discard storage protocol
Hand-editing sprint.json or treating --yes as human identity

roadmap.sizingRationale: Two sprints, not one: Sprint 1 is the daily live-edit path (honest handoff + requirement/task updates + local rules) and must be reviewable without mixing irreversible discard. Sprint 2 changes the future (roadmap) and the whole scope (discard) plus the skill exception that consumes remedyCommand. Not three: S2 and S3 share Plan 14 digest/lock and can ship with S1 as one public-edit unit. Split trigger: after Sprint 1 a user can correct current work and rules; they still cannot reorganize planned sprints or discard a live scope. S0 red fixtures belong in Sprint 1 before writers. Closed delivery decisions: origin/develop base; S2/S3/S4 may proceed in parallel after S1 within a sprint; S5 prefers in-band cancel from S2 but may use record-evidence --disposition.

sprints.title: Roadmap, discard y excepción de skill

previousSprint.summary: Permitir reorganizar entradas planned del roadmap, descartar un scope vivo orquestando writers existentes con un consentimiento, y hacer que el skill consuma remedyCommand + doctor, sin schema 5 ni journal Plan 15.
